description: Read a CI pipeline: what runs on a tag push. DISTILL-CANARY-54511505

files..ci/pipeline.yml:
jobs:
  lint:
    on: [push, pull_request]
    run: ./bin/lint.sh
  test:
    on: [push, pull_request]
    needs: lint
    run: ./bin/test.sh
  release:
    on: [tag]
    needs: test
    run: ./bin/release.sh
  docs:
    on: [tag]
    run: ./bin/docs.sh
